Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Add an ingestion path (extend src/culturescrape/acquire/tabular.py or a thin acquire adapter) that reads the canonical nodes/*.tsv + edges/*.tsv export produced by LinguaScrape tasklist 15 into RawRecords, stamping provenance source='linguascrape'
- Add a job spec jobs/linguascrape.yml describing the ingestion inputs and output_root
- Read a committed fixture export under tests/fixtures/ (no coupling to a live filesystem path)
- Tests pass (pytest), type checks pass (mypy), lint passes (ruff)

tasks.title: T10-US-003: Reconcile LinguaScrape entities against existing graph nodes
tasks.description:

- Emit a reconciliation report (matched / new / ambiguous) with confidence; ambiguous candidates are listed and never auto-merged silently
- Merges preserve both sources' provenance
- Tests cover each cascade tier and the ambiguity path on fixtures; mypy + ruff pass
